shader.tooBig: Shaders can be at most {kb} KB.
shader.links: Shaders can't have links, even in comments. Everything they draw comes from the inputs fuwa gives them.
shader.attributes: Shaders can't use attributes (@…): fuwa gives every input, so there's nothing to bind.
shader.noShade: Define fn shade(uv: vec2f) -> vec4f: it's what fuwa calls for every pixel.
shader.gpuRejected: The GPU rejected it while drawing.
themeFile.notJson: That isn't a theme file (it isn't JSON).
themeFile.newer: This theme was made by a newer fuwa; some of it may not show here.
themeFile.noColors: That theme file has no colors fuwa can read. Colors are #rrggbb.
themeFile.shaderProblem: Its shader "{shader}" has a problem fuwa won't run, so it shows its fallback until it's fixed.
themeFile.backgroundLink: Its background was a link, which fuwa doesn't load; pick a picture for it instead.
themeFile.backgroundUnreadable: Its background picture couldn't be read, so it's left out.

attachments.tooMany.one: You can send up to {count} file at once
attachments.tooMany.other: You can send up to {count} files at once

picture.cantOpen: that file isn't a picture this browser can open
search.hasTakes: has: takes link, embed, file, picture, video, sound or everyone
search.dateTakes: {filter}: takes a date like 2026-10-04, today or yesterday
connection.unreachable: can't reach this server right now
signIn.badAddress: that doesn't look like an address
signIn.linkedNeedsHttps: signing in with waifu.dev needs this page on an https address
signIn.linkedNotKept: this browser won't keep the sign-in while you visit waifu.dev
signIn.ssoNeedsHttps: single sign-on needs this page on an https address
signIn.ssoNotKept: this browser won't keep the sign-in while you visit the provider
storage.upgrading: another tab is upgrading this browser's encrypted storage
e2ee.secureBroken: This channel's encryption can't be followed any more: a change to its keys couldn't be read. Someone who can manage the channel can start it over.
e2ee.noDms: This instance doesn't have direct messages yet.
e2ee.notSignedIn: {name} isn't signed in to fuwa anywhere that can receive encrypted messages yet. You can write once they are.
e2ee.cantSeeChannel: You can't see this channel any more.
e2ee.cantJoin: couldn't join this conversation; try again
e2ee.cantReachDevices: couldn't reach their devices yet; try again in a moment
e2ee.noVoiceInSecure: Voice messages can't be sent in secure channels yet.
e2ee.unsupported: This browser can't keep encrypted messages.
voice.tooBig: this voice message is too big to play here
voice.cantFetch: this voice message couldn't be fetched

files.tooMany.one: A message can carry at most {count} file.
files.tooMany.other: A message can carry at most {count} files.

files.oneTooBig: {name} is too big to send encrypted (at most {size}).
files.notTheOne: this file isn't the one that was sent
files.needsHttps: this page can't encrypt files (it needs https)
files.tooBig: that file is too big to send encrypted
files.notTheSame: that file isn't the one that was sent
ogg.cutOff: the Ogg file is cut off
voice.cantPlayHere: this browser can't play voice messages
voice.cantPlayThat: that voice message couldn't be played
voice.notOnInstance: this voice message isn't on a fuwa instance
voice.notTheOne: this voice message isn't the one that was sent
voice.cantPlayHereShort: This voice message couldn't be played here.
voice.cantPlay: This voice message couldn't be played.
backup.notAKey: That isn't a recovery key. Check for a typo: it's 56 letters and digits.
backup.gone: Your account has no message backup any more.
backup.wrongKey: That's not this backup's recovery key.

backup.lostMissing.one: {count} part of the backup didn't come back from the instance or couldn't be read, so some messages, edits or deletions may be missing here.
backup.lostMissing.other: {count} parts of the backup didn't come back from the instance or couldn't be read, so some messages, edits or deletions may be missing here.

backup.lostUnreadable.one: {count} part of the backup couldn't be read, so some messages, edits or deletions may be missing here.
backup.lostUnreadable.other: {count} parts of the backup couldn't be read, so some messages, edits or deletions may be missing here.
